_doc: Known-good GIS fixtures: cases we have manually verified against the live county GIS.
Used by gis_smoke_test.py to detect silent endpoint staleness or drift.
How to add: after each weekly audit, pick 1-3 cases from the polished workbook where
you have HIGH confidence the GIS match is correct, and append below. Prefer cases from
the most recent 60 days so fixtures stay realistic. Once a fixture is > 6 months old,
the case may have transferred to an heir — re-verify or remove.
Each fixture is checked via lookup_by_address(address, county). PASS = at least one hit
AND (owner_contains is present in any owner field OR pid matches expected_pid).
verified_on YYYY-MM-DD — date a human last confirmed this answer is right.
expires_after_days — fixture skipped once age exceeds this (default 180).

Case 26E000709-120, property 109 Trantham St SW. Uses the NAME path: the Cabarrus Parcels layer has no situs-address field (only MailAddr1), so lookup_by_address can never match there. Cabarrus had NO smoke coverage until now; its ArcGIS server was found DOWN on 2026-07-09 (HTTP 200 + {"status":"error"}), which silently dropped every Cabarrus row as 'no parcel found'. Also guards the co-owner scoring fix: before it, 'BARBEE DONALD RAY | BARBEE LORETTA B' outranked this parcel.

Decedent Dorothy Lee Cline Pierce (case 26E000799-170), a Week 28 miss. Catawba had NO smoke coverage. Guards the new GeoServer WFS address path (catawba:parcels_plus) — lookup_by_address returned [] for Catawba until 2026-07-09. The deed reads 'PIERCE DOROTHY L TRUSTEE | THE PIERCE SR FAMILY TRUST'; that stray 'SR' used to poison _suffix_match_score and sink this parcel beneath a namesake at 2661 Robinson Rd.

Guards Catawba VALUATION enrichment. Catawba's PHP owner table carries no value, so every candidate arrived with market_value=None and both the $500K buy-box cap and the $10K floor were silently inert county-wide. Values now come from GeoServer. This estate also has a $2,000 vacant lot (369802981611, bldg_value=0) which exercises the bldg_value==0 vacancy rule.

Mecklenburg had NO smoke coverage. Guards the 2026-07-12 polaris3g name-search rewrite: parcel 21133808 (7314 Shadowlake Dr) is jointly owned 'THOMAS A PATTERSON | DIANNE M PATTERSON'. Before the fix, scoring only owner[0] (Thomas) rejected the decedent Dianne at 0.40 and the parcel vanished; and the broken bolt firstname filter blocked the lastname-only fetch. owner_contains checks for the SECOND owner specifically, so this fails if the joint-owner scoring regresses.
